findings.evidence: `rg` finds `of_apply` at line 101 as the sole theorem about `PiecewiseC1ClosedCurve.of`; generator lemmas `trace_of`, `isIn_of_iff`, `integral_of`, `windingNumber_of`, and `isNullHomologous_of_iff` at lines 140, 175, 212, 259, and 305 expose only the canonical extended coercion, not the supplied raw `γ`.
findings.fix: Add simp bridge lemmas for `FreeAbelianGroup.of (PiecewiseC1ClosedCurve.of γ hγ hclosed)` under the main cycle operations, and mark `PiecewiseC1ClosedCurve.coe_apply` as `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `PiecewiseC1ClosedCurve.of` only proves pointwise agreement; there are no lemmas reducing the integral, winding number, trace/containment, or null-homology of its generator to the corresponding raw-curve notions, forcing consumers to prove derivative and principal-value congruences through `Function.extend`.

summary: The raw-curve constructor exists, but its characteristic API does not connect raw curves to the cycle operations it was introduced to support.
